sections.title: Accumulation without a balance
paragraphs: Delivered services often need volume during a period, not an end-of-day obligation. A turnover register stores numeric facts for aggregation by dimensions. Do not invent receipt/expense semantics merely because balance registers are familiar. First ask whether the resource has a meaningful balance and explain it concretely.

sections.title: Interval and granularity
paragraphs: A weekly 60-minute turnover differs from a 20-minute closing obligation. Specify boundaries and grouping. One document with two services may create two records, so movement count differs from document count. Count recorder identities when the question asks for documents.
The virtual Обороты table accepts begin/end and Клиент=&Клиент. It represents computed platform totals, not a stored table containing 75. The full code selects МинутыОборот as Минуты.

sections.title: A repeat does not create another fact
paragraphs: Reposting replaces the current recorder’s set. Appending without replacement makes report volume grow after every correction. Test one two-line document, repost, line change and reversal. Reconcile by service and grand total while preserving document sources.

Verify 75 and two source-register rows filtered by your customer. An earlier empty period has no turnover. Exact endpoint events require an explicit inclusion policy; these movements lie inside a day and do not prove every time-boundary combination.

sections.title: Empty periods and boundaries
paragraphs: Test an empty period and records exactly at agreed boundaries. Including a whole final day must follow an explicit rule, not accidental parameter precision. Do not change document dates to force a match: correct the report condition in a separate copy.
The 46 mutation gives 76 instead of 75 while retaining two recorders. Test count and resource separately. Labor turnover is not remaining obligations: those are distinct questions/registers.

paragraphs: A helper definition is duplicated inside the startup handler. Keep one module-level helper and only its call inside startup.
Whole-register totals replace the own-key control. Filter by the actual customer/service/recorder reference for this experiment.
A runnable result is treated as proof of all accounting/security behavior. Record each checked mechanism and retain untested concurrency/edition limits.
